dedupe_keys.name: a forty year regional scale dataset of shoreline change and nearshore wave conditions in southeast australia

description: A Forty-year regional-scale dataset of shoreline change and nearshore wave conditions in Southeast Australia is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Yongjing Mao et al. Coastal erosion at wave-dominated beaches, primarily driven by nearshore wave dynamics, poses a substantial challenge for coastal management. While existing datasets from individual beaches have improved our understanding of site-specific coastal morphodynamics, there is a growing demand for regional-scale datasets to understand and predict regional shoreline responses to climate variability. Coverage: national (AU); published in 2026. Formats: CSV, NetCDF, GeoJSON. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
